names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 13803, «Иоанн (Золотов), мч.», with the rank word left off. The calendar gives him no office, which is what marks him and Nicholas (Gusev) off from the three priests they are named with.

death.note: The year the calendar's day line prints for the five of them together: «Сщмч. Афанасия, Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мчч. Иоанна и Николая (1937)».

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: days.pravoslavie.ru, 26 сентября ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Афанасия, Александра и Димитрия пресвитеров, мчч. Иоанна и Николая (1937).»
